scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @motobid/api" "npm run dev -w @motobid/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @motobid/shared && npm run build -w @motobid/api && npm run build -w @motobid/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @motobid/shared && npm run typecheck -w @motobid/shared && npm run typecheck -w @motobid/api && npm run typecheck -w @motobid/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @motobid/shared && npm run test -w @motobid/shared && npm run test -w @motobid/api && npm run test -w @motobid/web
